verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents concurrency-limiting strategies (per-key CEL-based limits, and CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST/OLDEST which drops queued duplicates) plus CEL-based event filters, which can partially collapse noisy event streams into desired runs. However there is no explicit debounce, delay-before-trigger, or event-batching feature documented. Missing for 10: explicit debounce/delay window configuration, event batching into a single run, and any hands-on confirmation these concurrency strategies are used for noisy-stream collapsing rather than just concurrency capping.
